_note: Clay recipes for our Actors. Source of truth for the site page /clay.html (copied to tacps126.github.io/data/clay.json), the README 'Use it in Clay' blocks and the post drafts. Public copy: no stack, tactics or infra. Column inputs: in Clay, '/Column' means type / inside the quotes and pick that column. Tested 2026-11-07: sanctions-screener in a real Clay table (limited Apify token works); the others with the same one-row input in local runs (speed below is that run, not counting Apify start-up of a few seconds); shopify-store-analyzer from its Apify health run. costPerRow = start fee + one result at the FREE tier price.

columns.title: Sanctions check
columns.gives: match, possible-match or no-match against OFAC, UN, UK, Canada, Switzerland and EU lists, with the listing, programme and source link

columns.title: Emails and phones from a website
columns.gives: public emails, phone numbers, social profiles and the contact page, read from the company's own site

columns.title: Official company registry record
columns.gives: registration number, legal form, status, founding date, industry code and registered address from the official register

columns.title: US import volume and suppliers
columns.gives: sea shipments in the last 12 months and the 12 before, growth, sourcing countries, product categories and carriers

columns.title: Hiring activity
columns.need: Company website (a name or a jobs page link also works)
columns.gives: open roles, roles posted in the last 7 days, split by function, seniority and location, a hiring signal score and the jobs page it found; companies without a supported jobs board come back as no-job-board-found at no charge
columns.tested: local: 15 of 18 company websites found their board, no wrong matches

columns.title: Shopify store profile
columns.gives: catalog size and freshness, price range, location, currency, payment options, public contacts and social profiles

columns.title: Recent news mentions
columns.gives: the latest news articles naming the company (3 per row here), with publisher, date and the article link

columns.title: YouTube video transcript
columns.gives: the full transcript text with title, channel, length, views and caption language, ready for an AI column to summarize

sources.title: Exhibitors of a trade show
sources.gives: every exhibitor of the show with website, country, booth and categories; add the contact-details column next

sources.title: Companies that just raised money
sources.gives: US companies that filed a Form D raise in the last 7 days, with amount, industry and named executives

sources.title: Newly registered companies
sources.gives: companies registered in the last 7 days with legal form, industry and address

sources.title: Companies hiring for a role
sources.gives: every company hiring for the role, with open roles and a hiring signal score

sources.title: Bank and court property auctions
sources.gives: upcoming property auctions from bank and court portals with price, auction date, location and a deal score
